caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile sampler with a patchwork-like composition, featuring various geometric, floral, and symbolic motifs in a grid format. Colors used include red, green, blue, yellow, and white, with each section or patch containing distinct patterns. The center of the textile has a large blue and white symmetrical star or flower shape, encircled by red and white floral designs. Surrounding the center are squares and rectangles with motifs such as birds, trees, and diamonds, as well as the repeated word “UNION.” The lower portion has rectangular areas containing the names “WILLIAM P. SCHAMP,” “ASBURY,” “1841,” and other text in white capitals on colored backgrounds. Some squares have complex patterns with stylized leaves, stars, and floral shapes, and a large stylized tree is depicted toward the bottom center. The composition is tightly arranged, with each patch bordered by linear divisors, and the entire textile has a visually intricate and colorful appearance.
title: Double Faced Blanket
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
